about_the_game:
The Idea Bookroom is a writing and reading software that not only provides pure text, but also multimedia or interactive components such as "Narrator", "Image", "ShowText", "StartPs/EndPs", "branch", "Floating Notes", "Reader Annotations", etc., which can greatly enrich the reading experience of readers.

The software currently offers features including user profile management, book management, reading history tracking, import/export functions, Chinese/English language switching, light/dark mode switching, and feedback mechanisms. Books can be labeled, assigned covers, and more.

You can download the Android version APK from the official , which is available for both Android phones and tablets. Please try it out~

The library also includes a built-in game called 'OverWorld Island'. When you're tired of reading, play games; when you're tired of games, go read!

Subsequent update plan:

Current matters

  • The preset books will be continuously updated.

  • We will continue to add and optimize reading components to understand and implement the functions required by readers/authors.

  • The storyline of the game 'OverWorld Island' will be continuously improved.

You can feedback in the software or in our discord/telegram group.
